Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Endgame
Cardtype: Master
Master.
Put this card into play. When game ends and there is more than one Methuselah left, each Methuselah gains X points for each capacity X between 1 and 11 for which he or she has the more ready vampires of that capacity than any other Methuselah. The prey of the Methuselah with the more points is ousted (no one is ousted if there is a tie for the more points). Any ready vampire may enter combat with another vampire of the same capacity as a  action that costs 1 pool.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Quick explanation: the card introduces a new way of scoring a VP when the game ends because of the time limit.
The player that has the best* diversity of ready vampires at the end of the game gains an additionnal VP.

*: different capacity, the bigger the better
